name: Template Item
description: An item to use for templates

name: Quartz
description: A common crystal that is usually white or clear with a glass-like appearance.

name: Turquoise
description: A blue to green mineral, often used in jewelry for its unique, vibrant hue.

name: Hematite
description: A shiny, dark gray mineral, often polished for use in jewelry and decoration.

name: Malachite
description: A bright green mineral with distinctive dark green banding, used in various decorative items.

name: Amethyst
description: A purple variety of quartz, known for its violet color and often used in jewelry.

name: Opal
description: A gemstone with a mix of shimmering colors, often containing specks of green, blue, orange, and red.

name: Azurite
description: A deep blue mineral, commonly used in jewelry and ornamentation for its striking blue color.

name: Lapis Lazuli
description: A semi-precious stone known for its solid deep blue color, often with flecks of pyrite.

name: Obsidian
description: A dark, glass-like volcanic rock, typically black in color and very smooth.

name: Agate
description: A type of quartz available in a variety of colors, often found with stripes or bands of color.

name: Bloodstone
description: A dark green gem with red spots resembling drops of blood.

name: Jasper
description: An opaque gemstone, often found in red, yellow, or brown, known for its grainy appearance.

name: Moonstone
description: A translucent stone with a white, blue, or silver sheen, reminiscent of moonlight.

name: Onyx
description: A smooth, black stone, often with white bands, known for its glossy finish.

name: Peridot
description: A bright green gemstone, known for its clear, glassy appearance.

name: Chalcedony
description: A form of quartz in milky or grayish-blue, known for its waxy luster.

name: Citrine
description: A pale yellow to brownish orange variety of quartz, resembling the citrus fruit.

name: Carnelian
description: A reddish-brown stone, often used in jewelry for its warm, deep color.

name: Amber
description: A golden to yellow-brown gem, often transparent, made from fossilized tree resin.

name: Garnet
description: A deep red gemstone, known for its glass-like luster and clarity.

name: Amethyst
description: A purple variety of quartz, ranging from light lavender to deep violet.

name: Jade
description: A green gemstone, prized for its smooth texture and rich, vibrant color.

name: Pearl
description: A smooth, round gem formed within the shells of certain mollusks, typically white or cream-colored.

name: Black Pearl
description: A rare and lustrous gem, this pearl features a dark, iridescent color, often with green or blue overtones.

name: Topaz
description: A gemstone available in a variety of colors, known for its brilliance and clarity. Often found in yellow, blue, and clear forms.

name: Aquamarine
description: A light blue or turquoise gemstone, reminiscent of sea water, valued for its clarity and deep ocean-like hues.

name: Alexandrite
description: A rare and valuable gem that changes color from green in daylight to red in incandescent light, prized for its unique optical properties.

name: Emerald
description: A rich green gemstone, valued for its vibrant color and rarity.

name: Opal
description: A gem with a play of iridescent colors, displaying a spectrum of hues within.

name: Sapphire
description: A deep blue gemstone, known for its hardness and luster, second only to diamond.

name: Ruby
description: A gemstone of a deep red color, highly prized for its hardness and vivid hue.

name: Diamond
description: The hardest and one of the most valuable gemstones, known for its unparalleled clarity and brilliance.

name: Sky Emerald
description: A rare variant of emerald with a lighter, sky-blue hue, combining the qualities of emeralds and sapphires.

name: Flame Emerald
description: An emerald with fiery red and orange inclusions, giving it a unique, blazing appearance.

name: Star Ruby
description: A special type of ruby displaying a star-like pattern of reflected light known as asterism.

name: Blue Diamond
description: A diamond with a rare natural blue color, highly sought after for its unique beauty and rarity.

name: Fire Opal
description: An opal with a bright, fiery coloration, ranging from warm yellows to rich reds.

name: Black Diamond
description: An extremely rare diamond with a dark, opaque color and a unique, enigmatic appearance.

name: Sterile Bandage
description: A Sterile Bandage can be used as an Action to cure the Bleeding Condition with a successful Medicine Check of 10 or higher.

name: Smelling Salts
description: Smelling Salts can be used to rouse an unconscious creature for 1 Minute. If a Creature roused in this way has less than 10 Health at the end of that minute, they fall unconscious again.

name: Medicine Kit
description: A Medicine Kit contains 6 Sterile Bandages and 2 Smelling Salts.

name: Weak Healing Potion
description: A bitter draught that heals the creature who consumes it for 2d4 health.

name: Smokebomb
description: A small vial which can be thrown, creating a 1 unit radius of smoke that lasts until the end of your next turn that also breaks line of sight. Anyone within the smoke is considered blinded.

name: Vial of Slow Poison
description: A vial of poison that can be coated on a weapon, piece of ammunition or used to lace a drink or food. When a creature comes in contact with this poison, they must make a resilience check of 7 or they become poisoned and take 1d8 poison damage at the end of each full rest.

name: Vial of Poison
description: A vial of poison that can be coated on a weapon, piece of ammunition or used to lace a drink or food. When a creature comes in contact with this poison, they must make a resilience check of 7 or they become poisoned and take 1d6 poison damage at the end of each turn.

name: Vial of Antidote
description: A vial of antitode that helps counter toxins, reducing the amount of damage from the next poison you take by 1d6 for the next minute, ending the poison if the affected character takes no damage after calculating mitigations.

name: Healing Potion
description: A bitter draught that heals the creature who consumes it for 2d8 health.

name: Tranquilizer Serum
description: A serum that can either be applied to a fabric and inhaled or delivered by a dart. When affected, a humanoid, monster or beast must make a resilience check of 5 or higher or gain the Sleeping condition for 1 minute.

name: Silver Idol
description: An Idol made out of pure Silver, often used in Rituals.

name: Golden Idol
description: An Idol made out of pure Gold, often used in Rituals.

name: Piece of Paper
description: A simple sheet of paper, commonly used for writing notes, messages, or drawing maps.

name: Treated Parchment
description: A high-quality parchment, specially treated to resist wear and tear, perfect for important documents or spell scrolls.

name: Vial of Ink
description: A small vial filled with quality ink, essential for writing or drawing on paper or parchment.

name: 40-Page Journal
description: A sturdy, bound journal containing 40 blank pages, ideal for recording adventures, keeping diaries, or sketching.

name: Beginner Spell Scroll
description: A piece of Treated Parchment with a Beginner Spell scribed onto it that has a Channeling time of less than 1 Minute and does not require Components. This can be learned by those who have access to both this School and Spell Level. This Scroll can be used as an Action using the Spell Attack and Spell Damage Bonus Modifier of the Creature who Used it.

name: Novice Spell Scroll
description: A piece of Treated Parchment with a Novice Spell scribed onto it that has a Channeling time of less than 1 Minute and does not require Components. This can be learned by those who have access to both this School and Spell Level. This Scroll can be used as an Action using the Spell Attack and Spell Damage Bonus Modifier of the Creature who Used it.

name: Journeyman Spell Scroll
description: A piece of Treated Parchment with a Journeyman Spell scribed onto it that has a Channelingtime of less than 1 Minute and does not require Components. This can be learned by those who have access to both this School and Spell Level. This Scroll can be used as an Action using the Spell Attack and Spell Damage Bonus Modifier of the Creature who Used it.

name: Expert Spell Scroll
description: A piece of Treated Parchment with a Expert Spell scribed onto it that has a Channeling time of less than 1 Minute and does not require Components. This can be learned by those who have access to both this School and Spell Level. This Scroll can be used as an Action using the Spell Attack and Spell Damage Bonus Modifier of the Creature who Used it.

name: Master Spell Scroll
description: A piece of Treated Parchment with a Master Spell scribed onto it that has a Channeling time of less than 1 Minute and does not require Components. This can be learned by those who have access to both this School and Spell Level. This Scroll can be used as an Action using the Spell Attack and Spell Damage Bonus Modifier of the Creature who Used it.

name: Repair Strip
description: Spend 5 Minutes applying this to a damaged piece of equipment such as a Shield, Weapon or Piece of Armor to negate 1 point of damage.

name: Pouch of Saltpeter
description: A pouch filled with saltpeter, an essential ingredient in alchemy, particularly for making gunpowder.

name: Pouch of Sulfur
description: A small pouch containing powdered sulfur, useful in various alchemical concoctions and for medicinal purposes.

name: Pouch of Nitrate
description: A pouch of nitrate, often used in alchemy and medicine, and as a component in the creation of explosives.

name: Vial of Mercury
description: A vial containing mercury, a rare and valuable liquid metal used in alchemical processes and for treating leathers.

name: Vial of Acid
description: A small vial of potent acid, capable of corroding metals and other materials, often used in alchemy.

name: Vial of Venom
description: A vial containing a dangerous venom, extracted from a poisonous creature, often used in alchemy.

name: Bottle of Vinegar
description: A bottle of vinegar, useful for cooking, cleaning, and certain low-level alchemical needs.

name: Mechanical Parts
description: A collection of various gears, springs, and small mechanical components, essential engineering recipes.

name: Iron Pipe
description: A sturdy iron pipe, commonly used in construction, or as a component in several crafting recipes.

name: Steel Pipe
description: A high-strength steel pipe, more durable than iron, suitable for heavy-duty construction or mechanical engineering.

name: Pouch of Caltrops
description: As an Action, a Creature can use this Pouch to spread enough Caltrops within 2 Adjacent Tiles. Any creature who moves through this tile takes 1d4 Physical Damage. For each Physical Damage that is not mitigated, the creature also loses 1 Unit of Movement when they take the Move Action until the start of their next turn.

name: Net
description: This item can be Thrown at a Medium or Smaller creature giving them the Grappled Condition if they fail an Athletics or Acrobatics Check of 8. This Net has 10 Structure Points.

name: Large Net
description: This item can be Thrown at a Large or Smaller creature giving them the Grappled Condition if they fail an Athletics or Acrobatics Check of 10. This Net has 20 Structure Points.

name: Mortar and Pestle
description: Used for crushing ingredients such as gems or organic materials into fine powders

name: Empty Vial
description: A small glass vial with a stopper, perfect for storing liquids, powders, or small items safely.

name: Fishing Pole
description: A sturdy rod equipped with a line and hook, used for catching fish in rivers, lakes, or seas.

name: A Simple Lock and Key
description: A Lock that takes a Thievery Knowledge Check of 9 or Higher to unlock

name: A Complex Lock and Key
description: A Lock that takes a Thievery Knowledge Check of 12 or Higher to unlock

name: Empty Bottle
description: A clear glass bottle with a cork, useful for storing liquids or small items during adventures.

name: Bottle of Resin
description: A bottle filled with sticky resin, often used in crafting, waterproofing, or as an adhesive in various applications.

name: Bottle of Tree Sap
description: A bottle containing natural tree sap, used in medicinal remedies, crafting, or as a sweetener.

name: Sack of Rice
description: A Sack of Rice has 10 Cups of Rice in it.

name: Sack of Beans
description: A Sack of Beans has 10 Cups of Beans in it.

name: Sack of Flour
description: A Sack of Flour has 100 Pinches of Flour in it.

name: Sack of Sugar
description: A Sack of Sugar has 100 Pinches of Sugar in it.

name: Vegetable
description: A fresh vegetable, such as a carrot, potato, or onion, essential for basic nutrition and cooking.

name: Fruit
description: A piece of fresh fruit like an apple, orange, or banana, perfect for a quick snack or as part of a meal.

name: Wheel of Cheese
description: A standard wheel of cheese, a staple food item offering good nourishment and flavor.

name: Wheel of Aged Cheese
description: A wheel of finely aged cheese, known for its enhanced flavor and considered a delicacy.

name: Pinch of Flour
description: A small amount of flour, a basic ingredient for baking bread or other pastries.

name: Pinch of Sugar
description: A pinch of sugar, used to sweeten foods and beverages.

name: Pinch of Salt
description: A small quantity of salt, essential for seasoning and preserving food.

name: Pinch of Pepper
description: A pinch of ground pepper, used to add flavor and spice to dishes.

name: Pinch of Spices
description: A mixture of various spices, used to enhance the flavor of numerous dishes.

name: Cup of Beans
description: A cup of dried beans, a staple food that can be cooked in a variety of ways.

name: Cup of Rice
description: A cup of rice, a versatile grain that serves as a foundational ingredient in many meals.

name: Bottle of Honey
description: A bottle filled with sweet honey, perfect as a natural sweetener or for medicinal use.

name: Bottle of Milk
description: A bottle of fresh milk, nutritious and used in cooking or consumed directly.

name: Chunk of Meat
description: A sizable piece of meat, can be cooked in various ways to provide a hearty meal.

name: Bottle of Cooking Oil
description: A bottle containing cooking oil, essential for frying, sauteing, and other culinary practices. Enough oil to last for a Week of Cooking.

name: Bundle of Peppermint
description: A bundle of fresh peppermint, known for its refreshing scent and use in teas and remedies.

name: Bundle of Guarana
description: A bundle of guarana, a plant known for its stimulating properties and use in energy potions.

name: Bundle of Licorice
description: A bundle of licorice root, often used in sweets and medicinal concoctions for its distinct flavor.

name: Bundle of Mandrake
description: A bundle of mandrake root, notorious in folklore for its use in magical practices and potions.

name: Bundle of Yarrow
description: A bundle of yarrow, commonly used in traditional medicine for its healing properties.

name: Bundle of Nightshade
description: A bundle of nightshade, a dangerous and poisonous plant used in various dark alchemical recipes.

name: Bundle of Incense
description: A bundle of aromatic incense, used to create a pleasant atmosphere or in ritual practices.

name: Bundle of Golden Poppy
description: A bundle of golden poppy, known for its bright flowers and use in sleep-inducing potions.

name: Bundle of Echinacea
description: A bundle of echinacea, popular for its immune-boosting properties and use in herbal remedies.

name: Bundle of Mugwort
description: A bundle of mugwort, a herb used in dream magic and various protective rituals.

name: Bundle of Mint
description: A bundle of fresh mint, commonly used for its refreshing taste and aroma in cooking and teas.

name: Bundle of Saffron
description: A bundle of saffron, a rare and valuable spice known for its unique flavor and coloring properties.

name: Bundle of Sage
description: A bundle of sage, often used for culinary purposes and in rituals for cleansing and protection.

name: Bundle of Gingko
description: A bundle of gingko leaves, known for their use in improving memory and concentration in alchemical brews.

name: Bundle of Valerian Root
description: A bundle of valerian root, commonly used in sleep aids and calming potions.

name: Bundle of Ginseng
description: A bundle of ginseng, prized for its revitalizing properties and use in longevity potions.

name: Vial of Flax Oil
description: A vial of flax oil, rich in nutrients and often used as a base for various medicinal concoctions.

name: 90 ft. Spool of String [30 Units]
description: This can be used to set up triggers for certain traps and does not affect the visibily of the trap.

name: 90 ft. Spool of Invisible String [30 Units]
description: This can be used to set up triggers for certain traps and adds +1 to the Required Search Check to reveal the trap this is part of.

name: Needle
description: A small Needle used for sewing, medical procedures or traps

name: Skinning Knife
description: A special knife that grants a +1 Bonus to Wilderness Checks while Skinning creatures and can be used to cut Leathers into smaller pieces.

name: Bottle of Lamp Oil
description: A bottle filled with oil used to fuel lamps, providing a reliable source of light for adventures and exploration in dark places.

name: Mining Pick
description: Used for breaking down rocks into smaller pieces or extracting metals from rock

name: Hand Saw
description: Used for cutting branches, small trees or wooden planks

name: 15 ft. Rope [5 Units]
description: A sturdy 5 Unit length of rope, useful for climbing, tying, or securing equipment.

name: 30 ft. Rope [10 Units]
description: A 10 Unit rope, essential for longer climbs or more complex tasks requiring more length.

name: 45 ft. Rope [15 Units]
description: A 15 Unit rope, versatile for a variety of situations, from scaling walls to crossing gaps.

name: 60 ft. Rope [20 Units]
description: A substantial 20 Unit length of rope, ideal for challenging climbs or when a significant length is necessary.

name: Ammunition Components
description: Basic materials required for crafting various types of ammunition, such as bullets or arrowheads.

name: Iron Ammoheads
description: Iron heads for ammunition, offering a balance of weight and durability, suitable for standard projectiles.

name: Steel Ammoheads
description: Steel heads for ammunition, harder and more durable than iron.

name: Lead Ammoheads
description: Heavy lead heads for ammunition, maximizing impact and suitable for highly customizable projectiles.

name: Throwing Ammunition
description: A small weapon that is thrown such as a shuriken, throwing knife, or dart that counts as a Small Object but deals an extra 1d6 Damage and have a +2 Bonus to Range.

name: Ultra-Light Ammunition
description: Extremely lightweight ammunition, designed for high velocity and accuracy, but lower impact. Used in Ultra-Light Ranged Weapons.

name: Light Ammunition
description: Lightweight ammunition, offering a good balance between speed and impact. Used in Light Ranged Weapons.

name: Heavy Ammunition
description: Heavier ammunition, designed for maximum impact and penetration. Used in Heavy Ranged Weapons.

name: Iron Pot
description: A Pot that holds 3 Gallons of Liquid

name: Iron Pan
description: A Medium sized pan used for Cooking

name: Cooking Utensils
description: A set of basic cooking utensils, including pots, pans, and cooking tools, essential for preparing meals during travels.

name: Cloth Sack
description: A durable cloth sack, useful for carrying and storing a variety of items, from food to small treasures.

name: Shovel
description: A sturdy shovel, indispensable for digging, whether for setting up camp, unearthing treasures, or other practical needs.

name: Treated Wood
description: Wood that has been specially treated to resist rot and insects, ideal for building or crafting durable wooden items.

name: Spyglass
description: A tube with a glass lense that amplifies distant objects when looking through. This grants a +1 Bonus to Search Checks relying on sight when looking at objects over 100 Units away.

name: Bola
description: A bola can be thrown at a Small or Tiny creature, causing the Grappled Condition if they fail an Athletics or Acrobatics against your Throwing Attack.  A humanoid or otherwise intelligent creature can use an Action to remove the Bola.

name: Torch
description: Can be ignited, giving off light in a 5 unit radius.  Lasts for 4 hours.

name: Oil Lantern
description: Can be ignited, giving off light in a 5 unit radius.  Lasts for 12 hours and can be refueled with a Bottle of Lamp Oil

name: Wearable Oil Lantern
description: This lantern can be ignited, giving off light in a 3 unit radius while not needing a hand to operate, as it can clip or hang onto a piece of clothing.  Lasts for 12 hours and can be refueled with a Bottle of Lamp Oil

name: Crowbar
description: A Crowbar adds a +1 Bonus to Strength Checks involving doors or opening containers

name: Bear Trap
description: When a Large or smaller creature passes through this trap, they must make an Initiative Check of 9, or they become Grappled. The Creature can use an Action to try to escape by making a Strength Check of 8 or higher. A Creature can spot this trap with a Search Check of 10 or higher.

name: Set of Manacles
description: Must be used on a Medium or Smaller creature that is either Stunned, Incapacitated or Grappled. Make a contested Athletics Check against Acrobatics or Athletics. If Manacles are placed on the ankles, the target becomes Incapacitated.  If placed on the wrists, the target can only take 1 Action on their turn.  A creature can attempt to break free of these Manacles with a Strength Check of 14.  Upon a failure, the character receives 1 Tier of Exhaustion.

name: Grappling Hook
description: This can be used as an anchor for a rope, capable of holding the weight of a Medium or smaller creature.

name: Tent
description: Provides limited protection from the elements and can shelter 2 Medium or smaller creatures

name: Bedroll
description: Provides limited protection from the elements. Provides Health Regeneration benefits from a Full Rest.

name: Flint and Steel
description: Can be used to Ignite flammable objects

name: Climbing Kit
description: This kit is filled with useful tools, such as Pitons, Crampons and a harness. You gain a +1 Bonus to Athletics Checks when you climb using this kit.

name: Disguise Kit
description: A single convincing disguise that gives a -2 Penalty to Insight Checks against your Persuasion and Performance Skills when trying to see through the Disguise.

name: Grinding File
description: Used for grinding down metals into fine dust. This takes 6 hours to file one ingot. One Ingot becomes 10 Pinches of Dust

name: Lump of Coal
description: A lump of coal, a common fuel source used for burning in fires, forges, and as a heat source for various needs.

name: Lump of Charcoal
description: A lump of charcoal, made from partially burned wood. Its used as a fuel source in forges and grills, and for various crafting and alchemical purposes.

name: Sharpening Stone
description: A durable stone used for sharpening the edges of blades and tools, keeping them in optimal condition.

name: Lump of Coke
description: A lump of coke, a fuel with high carbon content, essential for achieving high temperatures in forges and smelters.

name: Pinch of Obsidian Dust
description: Finely ground obsidian dust, used in alchemy and crafting for its unique properties and sharpness.

name: Bundle of Copper Wire
description: A bundle of flexible copper wire, useful in various crafting applications, including jewelry and electrical conduits in magical devices.

name: Smithing Hammer
description: A heavy hammer designed for metalworking, essential for shaping and forging metals in smithing.

name: Smithing Bellows
description: A large bellows used to stoke the fires in a forge, providing a controlled blast of air to increase heat.

name: Smithing Tongs
description: Long-handled tongs specifically designed for handling hot metals in a forge.

name: Lock Pick
description: As an Action, you can attempt to use this to pick a Lock, gaining a +1 Bonus to Thievery Knowledge Checks. The Lockpick breaks upon use unless the resulting Theivery Knowledge Check was higher than a 15.

name: Compass
description: While using a Compass to navigate, you gain a +1 Bonus to Wilderness Checks.

name: Chicken
description: A common domesticated bird, often kept for its eggs and meat.

name: Sheep
description: A domesticated animal valued for its wool and meat. Often found on farms and in rural areas.

name: Donkey
description: A sturdy, dependable animal used for carrying loads or as a mount for smaller individuals. Known for its endurance and stubbornness.

name: Work Horse
description: A strong and robust horse, bred for labor such as pulling plows or carts. Not as fast as riding horses but very reliable.

name: Riding Horse
description: A horse bred for riding, combining speed and endurance. Suitable for travel and everyday use.

name: War Horse
description: A powerful and well-trained horse, bred for battle. Strong and brave, ideal for knights and warriors.

name: Cloak
description: A piece of cloth or leather that is worn on the back

name: Thick Hide Cloak
description: A piece of cloth or leather that is worn on the back and offers modest protection against the elements

name: Lead-Lined Cloak
description: A cumbersome cloak that comes equipped with a thick hood, blocking light from any celestial body such as a sun, moon or star. The lead composition of this cloak makes it difficult to attack or defend yourself in but offers some protection against magics.

name: Gloves
description: Hand coverings that are made of cloth or other light material.

name: Leather Gloves
description: Hand coverings that are made of leather that offer modest protection against Heat and Cold

name: Armored Gauntlets
description: Hand coverings made of metal or other hard and flexible materials. Offers modest Physical protection at the expense of Initiative. Requires the Armored Fighting Module.

name: Armored Helmet
description: Hard headgear that protects the head. This adds a +2 Bonus Modifier to Checks against being Dazed and Stunned. Requires the Armored Fighting Module.

name: Silver Headband
description: A headband made of Silver

name: Beginner Wand
description: A small branch with an embedded gem used to channel magic.

name: Beginner Staff
description: A large, wooden stick with an embedded gem used to channel magic.

name: Silver Ring
description: A small band of silver that fits on a finger

name: Golden Ring
description: A small band of gold that fits on a finger

name: Platinium Ring
description: A small band of platinum that fits on a finger

name: Light Leather Bundle
description: A Thin bundle of Light Leather that can be cut into 5 Strips by using a Skinning Knife.

name: Heavy Leather Bundle
description: A Thick bundle of Heavy Leather that can be cut into 5 Strips by using a Skinning Knife..

name: Strip of Light Leather
description: A flexible and thin strip of leather, ideal for crafting lightweight apparel, pouches, or book covers.

name: Strip of Heavy Leather
description: A thick and durable strip of leather, suitable for making robust items like armor, belts, or sturdy bags.

name: Silk Bundle
description: A bundle of fine silk, luxurious and smooth, perfect for high-quality garments or decorative items.

name: Velvet Bundle
description: A bundle of rich velvet, soft and elegant, used in crafting upscale clothing or exquisite upholstery.

name: Basic Ration
description: A non-perishable, packed meal that provides no benefits.

name: Field Ration
description: A non-perishable, packed meal that provides an extra 1 Health at the end your next Full Rest.

name: Basic Meal
description: A basic dish that counts as 1 meal for the day when consumed.

name: Basic Snack
description: A small snack that does not provide benefits.

name: Improved Meal
description: An improved dish that counts as 2 meals and allows a Character to regain an extra 1d6 Health at the end of a Full Rest.

name: Improved Snack
description: An snack that grants 1d4 Temporary Health an hour after consuming it that lasts until your next Full Rest.

name: Fancy Meal
description: A delectable dish that counts as 2 meals and allows a Character to regain an extra 3d6 Health at the end of a Full Rest.

name: Fancy Snack
description: A delectable snack that grants 3d4 Temporary Health an hour after consuming it that lasts until your next Full Rest.

name: Cheap Bottle of Wine
description: A basic, inexpensive wine, enjoyable but not particularly distinguished in flavor.

name: Bottle of Whiskey
description: A standard bottle of whiskey, aged and with a robust flavor, suitable for sipping or mixing in drinks.

name: Bottle of Pure Alcohol
description: A bottle of highly concentrated alcohol, used for medicinal or alchemical purposes, or as a potent addition to beverages.

name: Fine Bottle of Wine
description: An exquisite wine, aged to perfection, known for its superior taste and quality.

name: Bottle of Cheap Ale
description: A simple, affordable ale, offering a basic and refreshing taste with no frills.

name: Bottle of Ale
description: A good-quality ale, offering a balanced and enjoyable taste suitable for various occasions.

name: Barrel of Cheap Ale
description: A Barrel of Cheap Ale that can fill up to 20 Bottles.

name: Barrel of Ale
description: A Barrel of Ale that can fill up to 20 Bottles.

name: Boots
description: A plain pair boots, made with cloth and light leather

name: Leather Boots
description: A pair of boots made from reinforced leather, offering slight protection against Cold and Fire.

name: Armored Greaves
description: Boot coverings made of metal or other hard and flexible materials. Offers modest Phsyical protection at the expense of Acrobatics and Stealth. Requires the Armored Fighting Module.

name: Lycanthrope Claws
description: Claws of a lycanthrope that benefit from skills with Slashing Weapons.

name: Musical Instrument
description: A musical instrument such as a flute, lyre or harp.

name: Expedition Supplies
description: A bundle of food, medicine and other supplies to support an expedition. A small and medium creature can be sustained on 1 per day and a large creature requires 2.

name: Saddle
description: A saddle, suitable for a medium-sized mount.

name: Large Saddle
description: A saddle, suitable for a large mount.

name: Candle
description: A thick candle with a long wick which can burn for several days, giving off a subtle light in a 2 unit radius. These types of candles are especially useful in rituals.

name: Arcantech Arm
description: A combination of mechanical parts, metal and residual magic that form a prosthetic arm, capable of replacing the function of a biological one. Implanting this arm reduces the user's maximum health and lightning mitigation by 3. If the wearer of this enhancement takes more than 15 lightning damage after mitigation, the device becomes disabled for 1 minute. Additionally, this enhancement does not function in nullfields or around other anti-magic effects.

name: Arcantech Leg
description: A combination of mechanical parts, metal and residual magic that form a prosthetic leg, capable of replacing the function of a biological one. Implanting this leg reduces the user's maximum health and lightning mitigation by 3. If the wearer of this enhancement takes more than 15 lightning damage after mitigation, the device becomes disabled for 1 minute. Additionally, this enhancement does not function in nullfields or around other anti-magic effects.

name: Arcantech Oculus
description: A combination of mechanical parts, metal and residual magic that form a prosthetic eye, capable of replacing the function of a biological one and allowing sight. Implanting this eye reduces the user's maximum health and lightning mitigation by 2. If the wearer of this enhancement takes more than 15 lightning damage after mitigation, the device becomes disabled for 1 minute. Additionally, this enhancement does not function in nullfields or around other anti-magic effects.

name: Arcantech Cochlear Device
description: A combination of mechanical parts, metal and residual magic that form a prosthetic hearing device, capable of replacing the function of a biological ear and allowing hearing. If the wearer of this enhancement takes more than 15 lightning damage after mitigation, the device becomes disabled for 1 minute. Additionally, this enhancement does not function in nullfields or around other anti-magic effects.

name: Sleep Potion
description: A potion that can be mixed with food or drink to cause the sleeping condition for 1d4 hours if a creature fails a resilience check of 7 or higher. After failing the check, the condition takes 1d10 minutes before taking effect.

name: Lesser Firebomb
description: A volatile mixture of sulfur and nitrate that can be thrown as if it were a small object that causes an explosion within a 1 unit radius of where it landed requiring all creatures within the area to make a defensive check of 7, otherwise they take 2d6 fire damage.

name: Potion of Restoration
description: A potion that cures any disease on the creature who consumes it after their next full rest.

name: Potion of Big Mind
description: A potion that causes the creature who drinks it to gain a 1d4 bonus to knowledge checks for the next hour. However, after that time elapses, they gain a 1d4 penalty to knowledge checks until the end of their next full rest.

name: Potion of Attraction
description: A potion that causes the creature who consumes it to become more confident and charismatic, gaining a +2 bonus to persuasion checks for the next hour.

name: Vial of Sticky Goo
description: A vial that can be thrown as if it were a small object that causes an area within a 2 unit radius to be covered in a sticky substance which doubles the amount of movement required to pass through.

name: Potion of Awakening
description: A potion that can be fed to a creature that is unconscious or sleeping, waking them up for 1 minute. During this time, they do not suffer the penalties associated with exhaustion or lifeline.  When this potion expires, the creature immediately gains tier 3 exhaustion and falls asleep.

name: Firebomb
description: A volatile mixture of sulfur and nitrate that can be thrown as if it were a small object that causes an explosion within a 1 unit radius of where it landed requiring all creatures within the area to make a defensive check of 7, otherwise they take 2d12 fire damage.

name: Potion of Rage
description: A potion that causes the creature who drinks it to gain a 1d4 bonus to strength checks and a 1d6 bonus to the primary damage on melee attacks for the next 10 minutes. However, each time this creature takes physical damage, they must make a resilience check against half the damage or become maddened against the creature that hit them.

name: Potion of Reflex
description: A potion that causes the creature who drinks it to gain a 1d4 bonus to initiative and dodge checks for the next minute. After the effects wear off, the affected creature gains a tier of exhaustion.

name: Potion of Quick Tongue
description: A potion that causes the creature who drinks it be able to charge spells with their free action for the next minute. However, when this potion ends, the creature becomes dazed for one hour.

name: Potion of Forgetting
description: A potion that causes the creature who drinks it be able to remove an eligble module and refund all the points.

name: Greater Healing Potion
description: A bitter draught that heals the creature who consumes it for 3d12 health.

name: Calming Potion
description: A potion that removes the Maddened or Afraid condition from a creature that is not caused by a magical effect at the end of their next turn but gains a tier of Exhaustion.

name: Bundle of Bloodthorn
description: A bundle of bloodthorn vines, known for causing anger, irritability and intense emotions in many humanoids when coming in contact with the thorns. This vine grows in several types of environments, but is often found growing around corpses.
